Align the head center and feet/laptop base identically in all frames, locked camera, identical scale. No zoom, no layout changes, no cell outlines, no numbers, no text, no watermark. Tail and skirt nearly stationary; arm genuinely changes pose, not merely whole-body translation. No floating punctuation.
